profile.headline: Staff Engineer
profile.summary:
Just a human with a passion for well-tested software, software design, and web accessibility.

- Programming languages: (proficient) TypeScript, JavaScript, Ruby, SQL, Shell scripting, CSS. (familiar) Kotlin, Java, Python, Rust
- Application architecture: Node.js (Express, GraphQL, Apollo), Ruby on Rails, Microservices, Serverless, Object-oriented design
- Databases: SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL (DynamoDB, MongoDB), Redis
- Agile software development: AWS, Terraform, Continuous Integration (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, Jenkins, Travis), Docker, Version control (Git)

positions.title: Staff Engineer
positions.description:
- Led planning and development for new platform frontend application. Standardized frontend development process and technologies across 4 autonomous teams.
- Delivered 30x faster load times to critical parts of our frontend app by rewriting hot paths with optimized, performant code.
- Drove adoption of modern best practices such as architectural decision records, TypeScript, and CI/CD.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architected and led software development of the core platform API using TypeScript, Node.js, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL. Contributed significantly to the React.js frontend application. Developed the majority of asynchronous AWS Lambda serverless functions.
- Improved developer output by 15%: Initiated mob- and pair-programming sessions, reducing the delivery time of key product features.
- Established technical foundation for the application through database diagramming, UML sequence diagrams, and technical specifications that guided the development team to efficiently meet product requirements.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Optimized application observability: Implemented tracing for the Node.js GraphQL API, PostgreSQL database, and AWS Lambda serverless functions; added request logging for all API requests; utilized DataDog application monitoring for automated error alerts. Utilized metrics to track a 30% reduction in API latency during the optimization project.
- Led the development of our B2C insurance application and contributed over 55% of the code in a team of 6 software engineers.
- Consistently acted as team lead, reducing boilerplate with custom generators, standardizing development with Docker Compose and Vagrant, and acting as a liaison between the Product and Engineering teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Ledger and consumer investment application
---------------------------------------------
- Designed and engineered a custom Rails-based application used by a consumer finance company
- Integrated with Kraken for Bitcoin funding and Mailgun for email
- Developed robust multi-currency reporting capabilities


Data pipeline
-------------
- Planned and implemented a data pipeline to aid business intelligence using primarily Stitch and dbt
- Developed custom application to pull data from a source unsupported by Stitch. Used Singer.io to build a custom containerized application, and provided client with Terraform files to spin up required architecture in separate AWS account

positions.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed user stories for our Web client, 3 different Rails microservices, and our Android app.
- Designed CI/CD pipeline a CI/CD pipeline and led adoption for backend services, built on AWS CodePipeline and CodeBuild.
- Reviewed architecture and design for new projects, flagged quality risks, and submitted proposals to bridge gaps in planning.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
Major accomplishments
--------------------------------------
- Developed a GraphQL API on Rails from scratch to identify users that match business-critical traits for test execution. This API allowed us to reduce our time spent setting up test cases and increase the specificity with which we could find test users.
- Lead testing on three different backend services and boosted integration test coverage for APIs from approx. 0% to > 90%
- Pioneered test strategies and methodologies for testing async services. We primarily use Kinesis for inter-service message passing, so I built utilities to consume and publish messages to validate both message consumers and message publishes are meeting acceptance criteria at an integration level.

Services tested
--------------------------------------
- GraphQL APIs
- REST API
- Mobile clients (Appium)
- Web clients (Capybara, Ruby Selenium wrapper)

Primary toolbelt
--------------------------------------
- Ruby
- RSpec
- Capybara
- Cucumber
- Appium
- Insomnia/Postman for API exploration

positions.title: QA Specialist
positions.description:
Responsible for testing updates to applications developed by any of the development teams at A•VIBE.

- Lead test development for critical APIs and functional processes
- Lead company in developing internal best practices for web accessibility
- Participate in several stages of the SDLC including planning, development, testing, and post-launch monitoring
- Debug applications; document source of issue and options for resolution
- Design and implement test plans for company-wide application testing
- Develop automated test suites with Postman, Selenium, Testcafe, and TestBox

I'm always pushing myself to learn more about how to build quality software. Some of the projects I've been working on lately include:

- Web accessibility! I've written documentation for A-VIBE on the WCAG 2.0 guidelines, built a reporter for pa11y (an excellent accessibility auditor - find the reporter at github.com/ericyd/pa11y-reporter), and assisted with retrofitting one of our client's sites to be compliant with WCAG 2.0 Level AA
- Load testing. Not my area of expertise but I've been exploring Gatling and using it to get metrics on site performance under various loads
- Security scans. I need work here but I am using OWASP ZAP to glean info about our apps' security
- Always pushing my team forward with testing. Some of our projects don't even have test runners installed so laying the groundwork is half of my battle.

positions.title: Computer Lab Coordinator
positions.description: As coordinator for a team of 15 student employees, I oversaw day to day operations as well as lead the hiring and training process for our team.  I consolidated and streamlined our training presentations to improve efficiency and generated software utilities for management use.  Additionally, I created a proposal for a Peer Mentor program to develop seasoned employees and improve the on-boarding process for new employees.

positions.title: Student
positions.description:
Numerical modeling and statistical data processing with MATLAB, including processing Lidar datasets and modeling contaminants in aquifers. (Numerical Modeling, Computer Applications)

Solid understanding of sedimentary structures, hydraulic properties of sedimentary rocks, and geomorphic processes at the Earth’s surface (Sedimentation and Stratigraphy, Surficial Processes)

Proficient in petrographic analysis of minerals (Mineralogy, Petrology)

positions.title: Office Manager
positions.description: As Office Manager, I assist Kimberly with a number of day-to-day tasks. I am responsible for making sure that the basic elements of a functioning office are handled properly and that Kimberly can focus on her core business without worrying excessively about supplies, scheduling, or organization. My job is fairly autonomous and widely varied. I work on everything from filing to document preparation to minor service issues with clients. In addition, I have helped Kimberly with projects to expand her business by leveraging connections with centers of influence and supplying key information to people that are connected to potential clients.

positions.title: Customer Service
positions.description: As a customer service associate, I helped with a number of assignments around the store.  I gained extensive sales and technical knowledge with almost two years as a sales associate in the computer department.  As I transitioned to the customer service desk, I became familiar with the inner working of our in-house tech support, Geek Squad, and the troubleshooting of complex client issues that arose.

volunteerExperiences.description:
I tutor adult students pursuing their GED.  Many of the students are previously incarcerated, which means that they already have an uphill battle.  The Londer Learning Center is run by Multnomah County and aims to provide opportunities for individuals re-entering society.

Sadly, the Londer Learning Center was closed in December 2017 due to budget cuts.
